dimensions.name: One-door doctrine enforcement
dimensions.description: Single public entry point per module enforced by decorator; multi-entry bypass raises typed exception.

dimensions.name: Merkle-chained evidence log
dimensions.description: Every operation emits a SHA-256-linked evidence bundle; full chain verifiable via merkle root.

dimensions.name: FSM-governed state machines
dimensions.description: Multi-step operations use explicit BaseFSM with defined transitions; illegal jumps raise FSMTransitionError.

dimensions.name: Fail-closed typed exception hierarchy
dimensions.description: All errors are typed subclasses of DojoError; no silent None returns, no bare excepts.

dimensions.name: DOJO_BYPASS constitutional tripwire
dimensions.description: Env var that trips every @one_door call; used in CI to detect accidental bypass of constitutional checks.

dimensions.name: Privacy tier enforcement (CONFIDENTIAL gate)
dimensions.description: CONFIDENTIAL/SECRETS tasks hard-blocked from external APIs at the routing layer; PrivacyTierViolation raised, network never touched.

dimensions.name: Constitutional passport (three-way promotion gate)
dimensions.description: Model cannot be loaded until Harvest+Dojo+Forge all return GREEN; passport carries Merkle root over all three receipts.

dimensions.name: Sovereign revocation endpoint
dimensions.description: Passport carries revocation_url; DanteAgents checks it at model load time regardless of expires_at.

dimensions.name: SM capability auto-detection
dimensions.description: detect command reads torch.cuda SM version and returns precision recommendations; rejects unsupported hardware before training.

dimensions.name: FP8 training (SM >= 8.9, Ada/Hopper)
dimensions.description: FP8 weight-and-activation training via TransformerEngine; rejected at detect time on SM < 8.9.

dimensions.name: BF16 / FP16 mixed precision
dimensions.description: Standard mixed-precision training; BF16 preferred on Ampere+.

dimensions.name: FP4 training (SM >= 10.0, Blackwell)
dimensions.description: 4-bit float training on Blackwell hardware; requires SM 10.0+.

dimensions.name: Quantization quality gate (PPL / F1 guard)
dimensions.description: Rejects quant output if PPL delta > 15% or F1 delta > 5pt vs FP16 baseline; QuantQualityRejected raised.

dimensions.name: Multi-GPU / FSDP2 support
dimensions.description: Full-shard data-parallel training across multiple GPUs via PyTorch FSDP2 or DeepSpeed.

dimensions.name: Single-GPU QLoRA speed (custom CUDA kernels)
dimensions.description: Custom CUDA/Triton kernels for QLoRA speed on a single consumer GPU; throughput vs standard HF baseline.

dimensions.name: SFT (supervised fine-tuning)
dimensions.description: Standard supervised fine-tuning with full or partial parameter update.

dimensions.name: QLoRA adapter training
dimensions.description: Quantized LoRA adapter training; 4-bit base model + trainable low-rank adapters.

dimensions.name: GRPO / PPO reinforcement learning
dimensions.description: Group Relative Policy Optimization or PPO with reward model; TRL-backed RL training.

dimensions.name: DPO / reward-model training
dimensions.description: Direct Preference Optimization and reward-model fine-tuning from preference pairs.

dimensions.name: Idle-time GPU training daemon
dimensions.description: Background process that reclaims GPU cycles when no interactive inference is running.

dimensions.name: Training data contamination detection
dimensions.description: Hash-checks training corpus against eval-gold set; PackContaminationDetected raised if overlap found.

dimensions.name: GPTQ quantization
dimensions.description: Post-training GPTQ quantization to 4-bit or 8-bit integer.

dimensions.name: AWQ quantization
dimensions.description: Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) for higher accuracy at 4-bit.

dimensions.name: GGUF conversion
dimensions.description: GGUF format export for llama.cpp / Ollama-compatible local deployment.

dimensions.name: Block-level quant with constitutional precision floor
dimensions.description: Block-level quantization with configurable precision floor; BlockQuantizer enforces floor and emits evidence.

dimensions.name: Single-layer VRAM streaming (constitutional residency)
dimensions.description: At most one model layer resident in VRAM at a time; WeightStreamer enforces this invariant with sovereign halt.

dimensions.name: KV-cache page streaming
dimensions.description: KV-cache pages streamed between GPU/CPU; KVCacheStreamer with constitutional capacity cap.

dimensions.name: Prefetch governor (lookahead <= 16 layers)
dimensions.description: PrefetchGovernor enforces max 16-layer lookahead; prevents CPU/RAM headroom overrun.

dimensions.name: OpenAI-compatible API server
dimensions.description: serve command exposes /v1/chat/completions and /v1/completions compatible with OpenAI SDK.

dimensions.name: Local model runner (GGUF / llama.cpp backend)
dimensions.description: Run quantized GGUF models locally via llama.cpp; zero cloud dependency.

dimensions.name: vLLM paged attention integration
dimensions.description: vLLM backend for high-throughput paged KV-cache inference.

dimensions.name: Multi-provider LLM routing
dimensions.description: Route tasks to 100+ cloud + local providers by cost, latency, and capability.

dimensions.name: Privacy-tier enforcement in router
dimensions.description: Router checks PrivacyTier before evaluating routing options; CONFIDENTIAL never touches external API.

dimensions.name: Local-specialist-first routing policy
dimensions.description: RoutingPolicy can specify LOCAL_SPECIALIST as top preference; cloud is fallback, not default.

dimensions.name: Cost tracking and per-request budget
dimensions.description: Track per-request USD cost; enforce max_cost_usd ceiling in RoutingPolicy.

dimensions.name: Fallback-on-unavailable policy
dimensions.description: Configurable fallback_on_unavailable flag; when False, raises hard error instead of routing to cloud.

dimensions.name: lm-eval harness integration (real tasks)
dimensions.description: Real lm-evaluation-harness benchmark tasks (MMLU, HellaSwag, ARC, etc.) run against the model.

dimensions.name: Eval-gold contamination detection
dimensions.description: Hash-checks eval gold answers against pack data; EvalContaminationError raised if overlap.

dimensions.name: Judge agreement stability gate (>= 80%)
dimensions.description: LLM-as-judge evaluation requires >= 80% inter-judge agreement; JudgeDriftError on failure.

dimensions.name: Merkle-stamped eval receipt
dimensions.description: Eval run exports a JSON receipt with Merkle root; used downstream by promotion gate.

dimensions.name: Synthetic eval fallback (no harness dependency)
dimensions.description: When lm-eval is unavailable, system falls back to synthetic task generation rather than failing hard.

dimensions.name: MLflow experiment integration
dimensions.description: First-class MLflow tracking: run logging, params, metrics, artifact URIs.

dimensions.name: Run logging (params, metrics, artifacts)
dimensions.description: Structured logging of training hyperparams, loss curves, and model artifact paths.

dimensions.name: Experiment comparison and leaderboard
dimensions.description: Compare multiple runs; surface best checkpoint by F1 or loss.

dimensions.name: W&B / Neptune / alternative tracker support
dimensions.description: Pluggable tracker backends beyond MLflow (Weights & Biases, Neptune, Comet).

dimensions.name: Model registry with URI scheme (dojo://)
dimensions.description: Addressable model registry using dojo:// URI scheme; register, lookup, and list artifacts.

dimensions.name: Pack import and provenance chain
dimensions.description: Import training packs with cryptographic provenance; signature validation and license check.

dimensions.name: License validation (allows_derived_ft)
dimensions.description: Harvest receipt carries license metadata; pack must have allows_derived_ft=True to proceed.

dimensions.name: CLI (completeness and ergonomics)
dimensions.description: Command-line interface covering the full train → eval → promote → serve workflow.

dimensions.name: PyPI availability, docs, and community ecosystem
dimensions.description: Published on PyPI, versioned docs, community forum/Discord, contributor base.
